text_blocks.snippet: Pre-glued lash clusters are individual or sectional false eyelashes with adhesive already applied to the band, allowing for a fast, mess-free, and glue-free application.
snippet_highlighted_words: individual or sectional false eyelashes with adhesive already applied to the band

list.snippet: Under-Lash Placement: Most pre-glued clusters are designed to be placed underneath your natural eyelashes (about 1 mm to 2 mm away from the waterline) so the band remains completely invisible and seamless.
No Separate Adhesive: Because the glue is built-in, you skip liquid glue bottles, sticky fingers, and waiting times.
Wear Time: Depending on the brand, wear time ranges from a single day (like Velour Lashes) up to 3 to 5 days with proper care (like Nanolash DIY Eyelash Extensions or Lash V).

shopping_result.title: Nanolash DIY Eyelash Extensions Stick & Go

list.snippet: Prep: Start with completely clean, dry lashes, and curl your natural lashes beforehand for a lifted, blended look.
Handle with Care: Use a non-stick applicator or tweezers to grab the cluster by the middle-outer section, taking care not to touch or press your fingers directly into the sticky base.
Apply: Look down into a mirror, gently lift your eyelid if needed, and press the cluster underneath your natural lash line starting from the outer corner and moving inward.
Lock In: Gently clamp or press your natural lashes and the cluster together using your applicator.
Removal: Peel or slide the cluster off gently (often starting from the band or using a bit of micellar water if recommended by the brand).

text_blocks.snippet: Tip: According to community discussions on Reddit's AustralianMakeup forum, users agree that stabilizing your hand (such as resting your elbow on a table) helps greatly with precision placement so the glue line doesn't stick to your tools.
